chunks: From him, from Mansour bin Al-Abbas, from Saeed, from someone else, that Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) was asked about the gracious living of the world.
He said: Spaciousness of the home and the abundance of those that love you.

key_terms.فَضْلِ عَيْشِ الدُّنْيَا: The excellence or graciousness of worldly life
key_terms.كَثْرَةُ الْمُحِبِّينَ: Abundance of those who love you

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Al-Rida say is the true meaning of a good life in this world?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam Al-Rida (peace be upon him) redefines worldly prosperity by emphasizing social connectivity and domestic comfort over mere accumulation of wealth. This perspective aligns with the Shia scholarly tradition that views the home as a sanctuary for spiritual and familial tranquility, where the presence of affectionate companions (*muhibbin*) serves as a tangible sign of divine favor and social harmony.

en.hubeali:
From him, from Mansour Bin Al Abbas, from Saeed, from someone else, 
‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> was asked about the gracious living of the world.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Spaciousness of the home and the abundance of those that love you’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Mansur ibn al-‘Abbas from Sa‘id from more than one person who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, was asked about the excellence of the worldly life.
He (the Imam) said, ‘It is in spacious house and in the great number of friends.’”
